AmazonBasics On-Ear Headphones Combining high-quality audio with compact portability, the AmazonBasics on-ear headphones make it easy to enjoy all your favorite digital content--from playlists to podcasts--while at home (without disturbing others) or on the go, bringing a little more fun to that long line, waiting room, or daily work commute. A standard 3.5mm jack (with a 90-degree angle) effortlessly connects the corded headphones to an Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, or other music-player device.
